topic: Understanding unique visitor metrics in analytics
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on clarifying how Unique Visitors and Total Visits are calculated within the airport analytics platform. Initially, [p1] questioned the definition of these metrics. Later, when presented with specific data points (356,028 Unique Traffic vs. 6,355,331 total), [p1] questioned whether simple summation was appropriate for 'Unique Visitors'. [me] confirmed that the current display method was agreed upon in a previous discussion involving someone named Nastya.
decisions: The unique visitor metrics are displayed as shown, despite potential mathematical inconsistencies when summing specific data points.
